statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Delayed NQ remains close to the prior close inside a narrow overnight range, with no current evidence of persistent one-way mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low while Stress remains extreme because oil is near $101, Treasury yields are elevated, geopolitical shipping risk persists, and PPI is due later today.
headline: NQ overnight range stays narrow while oil, yields and PPI keep Stress extreme
body: Delayed September NQ is 29,442 versus a 29,448.75 prior close, with an overnight range of 29,435.75-29,480.25. That price path is currently narrow and two-sided. Brent remains near $101 and the U.S. 10-year yield near 4.84%, while fresh Finviz context is mixed across megacaps and semiconductors.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, published Tail ranged from 18% to 43%. The 14:00 UTC hour peaked at 43% during trend-down conditions, the 12:00 UTC slot was unavailable, and subsequent repair returned Tail to 19% by 00:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: The overnight baseline remains low Tail while NQ stays rotational. Risk concentrates around PPI and jobless claims at 12:30 UTC and the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open; higher Tail requires observed post-release persistence, shallow retracements or repeated extension.

forecast.analysis: Tail stays low if early-Asia trade continues to rotate around the prior close. A sustained break that survives normal pullbacks would be the first meaningful deterioration checkpoint.
Low Tail is favored if overnight extensions continue to retrace. Repeated pushes in one direction with shrinking counter-moves would raise the probability of a pathological path.
Asia remains low Tail if neither side can hold the overnight extreme. A persistent extreme hold with shallow pullbacks would challenge the rotational baseline.
Late-Asia risk remains contained if directional efficiency stays low. A clean range escape that resists counter-moves would be the principal Tail escalation signal.
The Asia-Europe handoff remains low Tail if European liquidity produces counter-moves. Risk rises only if the handoff reinforces a one-way break rather than repairing it.
Early Europe stays low Tail while overnight moves mean-revert normally. A breakout that survives the first European pullbacks would increase directional conviction.
Tail remains low if European trade stays rotational. PPI proximity increases Stress, while Tail requires actual directional persistence rather than event importance alone.
The pre-U.S. morning remains low Tail if Europe does not establish a durable extreme. Oil and yields keep the environment stressed even without one-way NQ structure.

forecast.analysis: PPI and jobless claims arrive at 12:30 UTC. Tail remains WATCH before the print; the key checkpoint is whether the first repricing develops repeated extension and shallow retracements.
The first full post-PPI hour stays WATCH unless the released data produces a persistent move that survives pullbacks. The 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open adds a second structure checkpoint.
The conditional elevated score reflects the release-to-open transition only if direction persists through normal pullbacks. Orderly two-way price discovery would invalidate the elevated path quickly.
Tail falls back to WATCH if the first cash-session hour restores counter-moves. Persistent extension beyond the opening impulse would keep the higher-risk scenario active.
EIA petroleum data at 16:00 UTC can amplify energy-linked volatility. Tail remains WATCH unless oil and NQ align with persistent directional extension rather than ordinary whipsaw.

forecast.analysis: Afternoon Tail eases if post-data volatility decays and NQ regains two-sided trade. A renewed one-way leg would delay that normalization.
Late-afternoon WATCH is modest if cross-asset pressure remains elevated but NQ continues to retrace normally. Directional efficiency is the main invalidation.
Into power hour, Tail stays at WATCH only if earlier volatility leaves unresolved directional pressure. Balanced breadth and repeated counter-moves would favor further normalization.
After the U.S. cash close, Tail returns to low if futures reopen without an abnormal gap or persistent continuation. Geopolitical headlines keep Stress elevated.

The final forecast hour stays low Tail if overnight structure remains two-sided. CPI is still outside this 24-hour window, but inflation sensitivity keeps Stress high.
